hooks.command: $stdin=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $data=$stdin|ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd=$data.tool_input.command; if($cmd){ $b=($cmd -imatch 'git\s+branch\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*[dD][a-zA-Z]*|--delete)\b') -or ($cmd -imatch 'git\s+push\b.*(--delete\b|\s-d\b)') -or ($cmd -match 'git\s+push\s+\S+\s+:\S+') -or (($cmd -imatch 'gh\s+api\b') -and ($cmd -imatch '-X\s*DELETE|--method\s+DELETE') -and ($cmd -match 'refs/heads')); if($b){ (@{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='PreToolUse';permissionDecision='deny';permissionDecisionReason='Blocked by project safety hook: branch-deletion commands are disabled in this repo (see .claude/settings.json). Ask the user to delete the branch themselves if it is truly needed.'}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress) } }
